dogecoin.text: @TheSavageDrunk @dogecoin @elonmusk TL;DR: Crypto doesn't have CEOs, it's a joke

@TheSavageDrunk @dogecoin @elonmusk Cryptocurrencies can't have CEOs unless there's a registered company behind them... A cryptocurrency is a decentralized network, you may program its code but you can't actually call the shots since people on the network decide whether they upgrade their software. E.g. Eth and Etc

@Davidewatson2 @TheSavageDrunk @dogecoin @elonmusk Completely decentralised is a good thing but I agree that the other 2 are bad. That said Doge has a strong community so I think it'll keep growing for a few more years and might eventually get better developers.
